## Work Package WP01: Django App Scaffold & Models (Priority: P0) ✅ DONE

**Goal**: Create `sport_configuration` Django app with Sport, SportConfiguration, and OutfitConfiguration models.
**Independent Test**: Models can be created via Django shell; migrations run successfully; model tests pass.
**Prompt**: `tasks/done/WP01-django-app-scaffold-and-models.md`

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T001 Create Django app `src/sport_configuration/` with standard structure
- [x] T002 [P] Create `Sport` model with name, slug, federation_metadata, sport_icon, is_active
- [x] T003 [P] Create `SportConfiguration` model (1:1 with Sport) with team sizes, positions, formations
- [x] T004 [P] Create `OutfitConfiguration` model with project FK, outfit_type, colors, sponsor_config
- [x] T005 Add `sport` FK to Project model with `get_sport()` fallback method
- [x] T006 Create and run migrations for all models
- [x] T007 [P] Register models in Django admin
- [x] T008 [P] Create app README.md
- [x] T009 **Write `tests/sport_configuration/test_models.py`** (≥90% coverage per Constitution Art. IV)

### Constitutional Alignment
- Principle II (Architecture): Single responsibility app for sport configuration
- Principle III (Code Quality): Type hints on all model methods
- Principle IV (Testing): test_models.py with ≥90% coverage
- Principle XI (Documentation): App README required

### Parallel Opportunities
- T002, T003, T004 can be developed in parallel once app structure exists
- T007, T008 parallel after models complete

### Dependencies
- None (starting package)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Migration conflicts → Run migrations in isolated feature branch
- Project model changes → Use nullable FK with safe migration

## Work Package WP02: Service Layer (Priority: P0) ✅ DONE

**Goal**: Implement SportValidationService and OutfitLookupService with business logic.
**Independent Test**: Services can validate team size/positions and lookup outfits via Django shell; service tests pass.
**Prompt**: `tasks/done/WP02-service-layer.md`

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T010 Create `services/` directory structure
- [x] T011 [P] Create `ValidationResult` dataclass with errors/warnings structure
- [x] T012 [P] Implement `SportValidationService` with team size validation (warn, not block)
- [x] T013 [P] Implement position validation with flexible schema (warnings for non-standard)
- [x] T014 [P] Implement formation validation
- [x] T015 [P] Implement `OutfitLookupService` with Club→Team fallback
- [x] T016 Add type hints and docstrings to all service methods
- [x] T017 **Write `tests/sport_configuration/test_validation_service.py`** (≥85% coverage)
- [x] T018 **Write `tests/sport_configuration/test_outfit_service.py`** (≥85% coverage)

### Constitutional Alignment
- Principle II (Architecture): Service layer separates business logic from views
- Principle III (Code Quality): Full type hints
- Principle IV (Testing): Service tests with ≥85% coverage
- Principle VI (Reliability): Graceful degradation (warnings don't block)

### Parallel Opportunities
- T011-T014 (validation) can develop in parallel with T015 (outfit lookup)

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (models must exist)

### Risks & Mitigations
- Validation edge cases → Document all edge cases in service docstrings
- Fallback logic complexity → Unit test all inheritance scenarios
